name: Funabashi Haruka
source:
A newlywed homeroom teacher.

She's gentle and charming, and well-liked by her students.

She's easily swayed and has a weak personality. Her only previous romantic experience is with her husband.

Her husband is also a teacher at the same school, and is actually her childhood friend.

They've been together from kindergarten to university, and even work at the same company—truly a lifelong partner.

[From [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item152444?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
